_about: T21: the Tiro day's own timings (prologue, ritual, bout intros, aftermath). Session pacing only, no combat number. The ritual's hold is teach.json offerHoldS (docs/campaign/04-vr-campaign-design.md section 3). A missing or bad file fails the day (BeginArc). T28 set prologueMaxS, introS, aftermathTabletS and closingCardS, and T27 ritualLineS and ritualTimeoutS, from the C2 time budget (docs/campaign/05-c2-slice-story-bible-and-script.md section 4); each beat's floor (the earliest its skip works) and the intermission scenes are in story/slice.json.
_prologueMaxS: Card T21: the first-launch prologue is a static tableau, skippable by palming the centre stone. T28: 10 -> 45, the prologue beat's max in C2 section 4 (floor 6 s, natural 36 s); the centre stone skips from the floor (slice.json beats prologue.floorS).
_ritualLineS: T27: one dwell per ritual line, in order (C2 section 5 beat 2: RIT-01 12 s, RIT-02 14 s, RIT-03 12 s; natural 38 s). One line stands at a time (docs/campaign/04-vr-campaign-design.md section 2) and the last one stays until the offer or the timeout. With slice.json loaded the lines are its ritual beat's lines; without it the first dwell is Septima's fallback line, then the offer line. The offer counts from the ritual beat's floor (slice.json beats ritual.floorS, 10 s), or once the offer line stands when the slice is skipped. Every line but the last must have started before ritualTimeoutS.
_ritualTimeoutS: Card T21: 'a soft timeout continues anyway'. Counted from the start of the ritual. T27: 20 -> 45, the ritual beat's max in C2 section 4 (floor 10 s, natural 38 s).
_introS: Each bout opens on one intro line on the dais rail while the opponents stand on the sand; the kernel steps only after it. T28: 3 -> one length per Tiro wave index, C2 section 4 beats 3, 5, 7 and 9 (natural = max: 8, 8, 12, 12 s). A single number still means every bout.
_aftermathTabletS: The aftermath first shows the tablet with its heading line, then the closing line (card T21: 'a greybox stone tablet ... then the closing placeholder line'). Palming the centre stone ends the day only once the closing line stands. T28: 4 -> 16, the tablet beat's natural dwell in C2 section 4 (floor 5, max 18; the tablet itself has no skip).
_closingCardS: T28, new: the closing card (C2 section 4 beat 11: floor 6, natural 31, max 34 s), counted from the end of the tablet. The centre stone ends the day from the closing beat's floor (slice.json beats closing.floorS); at closingCardS the day closes itself, so no beat waits for the player.
